note: field 1 of SyncActionValue is `optional int64 timestamp`, written here as wire type 2 wrapping the legal `08 20`. protobufjs runs its generated `reader.int64()` regardless of the wire type, flattens the wrapper and reports timestamp 32; the bridge treats the mismatched field as unknown and reports {}. Pinned here because the nesting-bomb mutator only reaches it on some seeds, and proto-wire-type-mismatch-ignored-upstream would otherwise be reported as an allowlist entry that excuses nothing.
